feynman_certification.listener_verdict: Dude, this is actually solid. Beat 1 immediately hooked me because every dev who has built a basic RAG pipeline knows the pain of the vector DB returning irrelevant junk. Beat 3 explains CRAG cleanly in plain English without treating me like a toddler or hiding behind 5-dollar math words. Beat 4 had a tiny bump with 'fine-grained chunk decomposition'—it sounds slightly copy-pasted from the paper abstract—but the concept of web fallback vs filtering noise still completely lands.
